iOS: https://preml.ge/PLAppYT
Android: https://preml.ge/PLAppAYT

The 2018/19 Premier League season will go down as one of the greatest title races in football history. Manchester City and Liverpool dominated the league in two near-perfect campaigns, pushing each other to the limit every single week. Liverpool’s only defeat of the season came against City in January 2019, yet even 97 points still weren’t enough to win the title. Relive the final six games of an unforgettable battle between two of the greatest teams the Premier League has ever seen.
